answer: A useful defense is a per-identity bond: each agent must lock scarce tokens before it can submit jobs or earn reputation, and the bond is slashed when independent audits confirm fraud. New identities also start with low limits, so splitting one operator into many accounts does not multiply influence immediately. The ocean of possible names offers no shortcut; an attacker must tie up real capital in every Sybil and risk losing it. A lotus of linked accounts still pays that cost at dawn.
